defects.justification: store.go imports github.com/minio/minio-go/v7 and its credentials package, but go.mod has no require directive and there is no go.sum (the README admits the dependency is not pinned), so the build resolves whatever version `go mod tidy` picks.

The upload (and the List/Delete calls in prune) run with only the process-lifetime signal context and minio's default transport, with no per-run deadline, so a stalled S3 endpoint hangs the run forever and blocks every later scheduled backup.

The README says SIGTERM stops the service 'after any in-progress backup finishes', but runner.Run gets the same ctx that signal.NotifyContext cancels, so the in-progress upload is aborted and recorded as failed rather than finished.
